verdict.rationale: WorkOS AuthKit is explicitly documented as a 'spec-compatible OAuth authorization server' designed to secure MCP servers with minimal effort, and WorkOS docs describe built-in support for MCP and OAuth applications. A live probe against mcp.workos.com confirms the endpoint gates MCP sessions behind OAuth (401 unauthorized until a spec-compliant client completes the flow), corroborating the documented behavior in production. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reports validating scoped token issuance and verification end-to-end, and more detail on token scope granularity for remote agents.
